title: Cillerian SMP
description: Minecraft Modpack for the Cillerian Charity Month
body:
Welcome to a modpack that we made for the Cillerian Charity Month! Dive into a modded world designed for exploration, technical creativity and a great cause.

🗺️ **What Awaits You?** A Vanilla+ Minecraft Universe! This modpack transforms the vanilla Minecraft experience into a massive adventure:

**The Big Exploration:** Prepare to explore a completely revamped world thanks to mods like YUNG's Better Structures (Strongholds, Witch Huts, Bridges), Cave Biomes, and other exploration enhancers. Discover new dungeons, biomes, and secrets around every corner!

**Engineering Marvels:** For the builders and thinkers, the acclaimed Create mod is the core of our technical experience. Not to forget the new Create Mod, Aeronautics. Get ready to build machines like you never did berfore.

**Quality of Life:** We’ve included essential mods for smoother gameplay, better inventory management, and improved performance, ensuring smooth fps and a great adventure while you stream.

💖 **Play, Watch, and Donate!** This isn't just a modpack we made for fun; it's a part of the charity event.

**Our Goal:** Raise awareness and funds for **Gut Aiderbichl**!

We are hosting a big server with lots of different streamers that all help us raise funds for the charity. Tune in throughout the month to see the community's progress, celebrate milestones, and join special in-game events.

For stream details, donation links, and the full event schedule, please check the Cillerian Discord: https://discord.gg/4v33TnC6aA
